skills.name: using-skillgrid
skills.desc: Invoke before any response. Routes the phase, checks config/resume/domain-model, enforces context discipline and skill priority.

skills.name: onboarding
skills.desc: One-time setup: detect stack/testing/tracker/security, confirm facts (blocking), write .skillgrid/config.yaml + AGENTS.md block.

skills.name: writing-blueprints
skills.desc: Write a bite-sized TDD plan (blueprint.md): Must-Haves, one-way-door tags, no placeholders, self-review + fresh-eyes plan review.

skills.name: slicing
skills.desc: Break the blueprint into vertical tracer-bullet tickets with dependency edges and execution waves.

skills.name: qa
skills.desc: The quality gate: test plan, goal-backward verification, verification-gap/traceability/test-quality/security/code-quality audits.

skills.name: ticketing
skills.desc: Publish sliced tickets to the configured tracker (Backlog.md / gh / glab / jira); run the status machine.

skills.name: interviewing
skills.desc: Interview the user via a design-tree frontier in rounds until a weighted clarity gate passes; maintain glossary/ADRs as terms resolve.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.desc: Turn ideas into designs via 4 classified paths (spike / bounded / new-project / new-function) with a hard approval gate before implementation.

skills.name: spike
skills.desc: Throwaway feasibility experiment producing an evidence-gated verdict (VALIDATED / INVALIDATED / PARTIAL) + one liftable pure module.

skills.name: sketch
skills.desc: Build throwaway interactive UI mockups (2–3 structurally different variants) to get a felt verdict + constraints for the real build.

skills.name: research
skills.desc: Lightweight single-pass research against primary sources with epistemics; appends a cited Research: section to findings.md.

skills.name: code-research
skills.desc: Heavy informational research: fan out parallel researcher subagents (researcher / verifier / red-team), verify claims, red-team conclusions.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.desc: Long-horizon experimental research: two-loop hypothesis → experiment → measure cycles with persistent state and direction decisions.

skills.name: simple-execution
skills.desc: Inline plan execution: load/review plan, TDD per task, QA gate, request review, finish branch; stops and asks on blockers.

skills.name: subagent-execution
skills.desc: Execute a plan with a fresh implementer subagent per task, per-task spec+quality review, 5-round fix loop, final QA + whole-branch review.

skills.name: parallel-execution
skills.desc: Dispatch one subagent per independent problem domain in the same message (parallel); integrate from a fan-out ledger.

skills.name: work-unit-commits
skills.desc: Canonical commit protocol: conventional commits, atomic sizing, [skillgrid-context] block, git-hook guards, checkpoint.json resume handle.

skills.name: resume
skills.desc: Re-orient from durable state (execution ledger, checkpoint.json, spec-zone artifacts, Mnemonic fallback) — files win over conversation memory.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.desc: Iron-law TDD: no production code without a failing test first; red → green → refactor.

skills.name: test-driven-verification
skills.desc: The Gates contract: every requirement carries G<n> oracles (CHECK: + EXPECT:); a gate is met only when freshly run.

skills.name: acceptance-test-authoring
skills.desc: Author BDD acceptance suites: Gherkin-in-Markdown acceptance.feature, cucumber-js runner, extraction contract, page-object model.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.desc: Dispatch two parallel reviewer subagents on two axes — Standards (glossary/ADRs) and Spec (BDD scenarios) — then triage findings.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.desc: Handle review feedback with technical rigor (verify, push back, no performative agreement); own the triage → fix → validate loop.

skills.name: parallel-code-review
skills.desc: Heavy review: fan out 6 specialist reviewers (standards, spec, edge cases, verification gaps, security, red team) in parallel, then verdict.

skills.name: ship
skills.desc: Integrate the change to its base branch (merge / PR / keep — tests green on the integrated tree), then move the change folder specs/ → archive/.

skills.name: document
skills.desc: Write the human-facing record from the real diff, never from memory: PR body, changelog, release note, postmortem. Prose only.

skills.name: reflect
skills.desc: Terminal phase: writes the single report.md (final-state facts, gate results, Decisions/Lessons/Patterns/Surprises, advisory verdict, open decision debt).

skills.name: mnemonic
skills.desc: Operate Skillgrid's persistent memory (SQLite + FTS5): mem_save/recall protocol, code-index ladder, web cache, session summary rules.

skills.name: isolated-workspace
skills.desc: Ensure an isolated workspace (native worktree tools first, git worktree fallback); detect existing isolation; run setup + baseline tests.

skills.name: structured-debugging
skills.desc: Root-cause-first debugging: 4 phases (investigate → pattern → hypothesis → implement); 3 fixes fail → question architecture; debug state survives compaction.

skills.name: architectural-decision-records
skills.desc: Build/sharpen the domain model (glossary business.md + technical.md) and record ADRs (5 styles, immutable once accepted, per-change Review Manifest).

skills.name: ponytail
skills.desc: Enforce the laziest working solution via a 7-rung ladder (YAGNI → codebase → stdlib → native → installed dep → one-liner → minimal); always-on.
